posts.headline: The Thicks strut in with a ring, but a 5.5 average finish says the champagne was flatter than their season-long consistency.
posts.detail: Tyrique14 won it all in 2025, but the career resume still reads a best finish of 3rd and a worst of 8th — that's not a dynasty, that's a lucky bounce, and this league remembers.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner has the best resume in the building and still ZERO rings to show for it.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra owns a ridiculous 20-8 career record and a 1.5 average finish — best in the league — but no titles means all that regular-season swagger has meant nothing when it counts... yet.

posts.headline: Chauncey finished dead last a year ago and nothing on this roster suggests the basement lease is up.
posts.detail: talentedtenthh posted a 4-10 record and a league-worst 12th place finish in Season 1 — the definition of a bottom-feeder walking straight back into the fire.

posts.kicker: RING DOESN'T LIE... OR DOES IT?
posts.headline: Megamind's got a championship on the shelf but a losing career record — explain that one.
posts.detail: Sasinci's World is 13-15 all-time with a 5.5 average finish despite the title, proving that one hot month can paper over a whole lot of mediocrity.

posts.headline: The Prince of Persia reigns over a kingdom of 11th-place finishes and nobody's trembling.
posts.detail: SwooshAnoosh limped to a 5-9 record and dead-last-adjacent 11th place finish in their debut season — royalty in name only.
